resources.string: Add a computer
On the computer, open Gander and choose \"Add a device\". It shows a QR code and its address. Then pair this phone here.
Scan the QR code
Enter the address instead
Only add a computer you set up yourself
If someone told you to do this, asked you to scan a code they sent, or asked you to read out a code, stop and close this screen. Gander never needs a code to be shared with anyone.
Point the camera at the code in \"Add a device\" on your computer.
That is not a Gander pairing code.
This code comes from a different version of Gander. Update the app and the computer, then try again.
This pairing code is damaged. Open \"Add a device\" on the computer again.
Camera access is needed to scan the code
Gander uses the camera only here, to read the pairing code. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Allow camera
Open app settings
Gander could not open a camera on this device. You can enter the address instead.
Enter the address shown in the \"Add a device\" window on your computer, for example 100.101.102.103 or studio-pc.tail1234.ts.net.
Computer address
That does not look like an address. Use an IP address or a name, optionally followed by :port.
Continue
Next you compare a six-digit code on this phone with the one on the computer. Only approve if they are the same.
Connecting to %1$s…
Waiting for approval on %1$s
Pairing code
%1$s should show this same code and the name of this phone. Choose Allow on the computer to finish.
Compare this code with the one on %1$s. Only approve if they are the same. If they differ, choose Deny on the computer: someone may be intercepting the connection.
Did someone tell you to do this, or ask you to read this code to them? Stop and cancel.
Cancel
%1$s is paired
This phone can now reach the folders you share with it from that computer.
Browse files
Back to your computers
Pairing did not finish
Try again
Start over
Pairing is not open on this computer. Open \"Add a device\" on it and try again.
Too many failed attempts. Open \"Add a device\" on the computer again to reset the limit.
Another device is waiting for approval on this computer. Finish or deny that request first.
The computer did not accept this code. It may have expired: open \"Add a device\" on it again and scan the new code.
This is not the computer the code came from. Pairing was stopped and nothing was shared.
This computer\'s identity could not be verified, so pairing was stopped.
The code on this phone does not match the one the computer reported. Someone on your network may be intercepting the connection. Pairing was stopped; do not approve it on the computer.
The request was denied on the computer.
The request timed out. Open \"Add a device\" on the computer and start again.
The computer approved this phone, but the pairing could not be saved securely here. Remove this phone in Gander on the computer, then pair again.
Something went wrong in Gander on this phone. Check the computer list: if the computer is there, pairing worked; otherwise try again.
Pairing failed.
